title: 47.8% of blocked verdicts carry a class word VERDICT_CLASSES lacks; bus.sh and fixer.md teach a second vocabulary
claim: Over the 569 merged pull requests first-parent in v7.1.0..92d38ecb, 214 of the 448 parseable blocked verdicts (0.478; 93 distinct words, on 155 PRs) carry a class word that web-fix-wave.js's VERDICT_CLASSES does not hold, so parseVerdict routes every one to `other` and no bucket can be read off the grammar for them; 71 of them (ci-red 63, ci-cancelled 4, ci-pending 2, red-unanswered 1, body 1) are words that bus.sh's MECHANICAL_CLASSES and fixer.md's 'Never for a mechanical-only gap' paragraph teach, 9 of bus.sh's 12 mechanical words being absent from VERDICT_CLASSES.
mechanism: Two writers of the block vocabulary and one reader: VERDICT_CLASSES (web-fix-wave.js, read by policy_lint.mjs:blockClasses and the wave's parseVerdict) and MECHANICAL_CLASSES (tools/audit/seat/bus.sh:672, taught by dev/governance/roles/fixer.md:311), while fix-review.md teaches the class as free `[a-z-]+`. check-wave-script.mjs's taught-word check reads only `blocked <sha> <word>:` examples in briefs, so fixer.md's prose list and bus.sh's shell variable never meet it. The same verdict is therefore `mechanical` to bus.sh dispatch and `other` to the wave and the --stats class table; 143 further verdicts are untaught by both (bus.sh's 'an unknown one refuses').

evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out; a count over the committed snapshot window.json, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb teach-ci-red: the VERDICT_CLASSES literal of .claude/workflows/web-fix-wave.js edited in memory to carry 'ci-red', read through policy_lint.mjs:blockClasses

metric_definition: blocked verdicts (trimmed first line of an issue comment or review parsing under VERDICT_RE's blocked arm) whose statsHistogram class word is not in blockClasses(), over the window
phenomenon_property: Every class word a seat is taught to write in a blocked verdict (fix-review.md, fixer.md, bus.sh's MECHANICAL_CLASSES) is one word list, the one VERDICT_CLASSES holds, so the wave, bus.sh dispatch and the --stats class table route each verdict alike
seam_rule: grep -nE '^MECHANICAL_CLASSES=|^const VERDICT_CLASSES' tools/audit/seat/bus.sh .claude/workflows/web-fix-wave.js; HPO_PLANDATA=$(mktemp -d) node dev/audit/rounds/round11/D13/s2/block_classes.mjs --no-window-read | grep UNTAUGHT

null_control.note: the brief's fixture perturbation: one verdict re-shaped out of the grammar moves the population by exactly one, so the harness counts verdicts and not rows

proposed_fix_scope: One block vocabulary: VERDICT_CLASSES carries bus.sh's mechanical words (or bus.sh derives MECHANICAL_CLASSES from it), fix-review.md's class teaches that list rather than any [a-z-]+, and check-wave-script.mjs's taught-word check reads fixer.md's mechanical list and bus.sh's variable
